title: The halls and societies he knew
summary: White names the halls he frequented, including St. Dominic, Economy Hall and others, and the clubs and societies he followed.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I wouldn't been to the Connemy Hall, the San Sioux Hall, you know where the San Sioux Hall is there? The St. Dominic. I don't know where that's at. That's up in Coctin. That's up on the bridge between Genet and Hickory. But it's mostly locally on the riverside. That's where it's at. I done been to most of all them. And the San Siouxs, I done been there so many times. San Siouxs, the Connemy Hall, the New Hall, the Copper Reds Hall. Them Halls, I used to know them. I know them all. I believe your wife put her hanker to tie my eyes. I walk right to her. Show you how much I know all them different halls, you see. Them, you go to them halls, you sit down there and have pleasure. You wouldn't be go sit down there. Sit down there and enjoy yourself and laugh and talk and have fun with them. Mostly all them white musicians would get killed. Because we used to say, you used to say, how much? I said, why? They say, how you know all them, how you know all them, how you know all them existing? I said, how I know them? I said, because I'm taking line behind them so much. I said, I done taking line behind them so much. I said, I mean them. I said, I might not know. I might not know the name. You know what I mean? I might not know the name, but I said, don't think I don't know them. I know them, but I might not know them. I said, well, I'll be John Brown. I'll be John Brown if you don't know where. There's no way you can go. If you can go, then you can't everybody like you. And don't care where you go. There's always somebody, always a musician to know you. dear I was playing at St. Dominic. We had a dance at St. Dominic. I said, yeah? I said, well, St. Dominic, you don't come up around the St. Sioux Hall no more, St. Dominic Hall. I said, man, there's nothing around the St. Dominic Hall. I said, there's nothing up there no more. The Bulls Club, I used to find the Bulls Club. Behind them, that used to be on 8th Street, behind the Bulls Club, the Line, the Sinner Simmons. All them clubs I used to be with. And neither society can call if I don't know them.
